source.title: INGT — Carta Agrícola de Cabo Verde
source.attribution: INGT — Instituto Nacional de Gestão do Território

methodology.areaFieldAssessment: Área_Km2 is not used for totals: 47 of 48 source records contain zero.
methodology.calculatedAreaMethod: Source-returned WGS84 polygons; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid with holes respected; square metres divided by 10,000 and reported as hectares.
methodology.aggregationMethod: Polygons are unioned within each classification before calculating classification area.
methodology.overlapCaveat: Different source classifications overlap. Gross classification totals must not be summed as unique island coverage.
